responsibility: Implements the main C backend for the MicroBlaze target, providing the target hook logic that connects generic GCC middle-end and RTL code generation to MicroBlaze ABI, addressing, calling convention, frame layout, section selection, PIC/TLS handling, constant and address legitimacy, register/mode constraints, reload decisions, asm output, cost modeling, scheduling adjustments, trampoline/thunk support, and target-specific reorganization such as optional prefetch-related instruction insertion. It owns key target data structures like address classification and frame information and supplies the hook implementations named by targetm that consume GCC trees/RTL and produce MicroBlaze-specific RTL decisions and final assembly behavior.
same_name_distinction: This is the executable backend implementation file for the MicroBlaze port: it defines the target hook functions, targetm initializer, frame/address analysis structures, and C code for behaviors such as PIC/TLS handling, calling conventions, asm emission, and machine-dependent reorg/prefetch insertion. Unlike microblaze.h it declares no compile-time target macro/spec interface, unlike microblaze.md it does not encode insn patterns and scheduling in machine-description form, and unlike microblaze.opt it is not the generated-option definition table.
